name: Netmend Sheets AI
title: AI functions in Google Sheets with your own free Gemini key
desc: Add =NETMEND_AI(), translate, extract, classify and sentiment functions to Google Sheets. Free, open Apps Script code, your own Gemini key, no add-on permissions to a third party.
h1: AI inside Google Sheets, as a formula
intro: Type =NETMEND_AI("Write a product title for", A2) and drag it down. Netmend Sheets AI adds AI formulas to any Google Sheet with a short Apps Script you install yourself, using your own free Gemini key.
